tokens.npc_dota_hero_dark_seer_bio:
Fast when he needs to be, and a cunning strategist, Ish'Kafel the Dark Seer requires no edged weapons to vanquish his enemies, relying instead on the strength of his powerful mind. His talent lies in his ability to maneuver the fight to his advantage. Hailing from a place he calls 'The Land behind the wall,' Dark Seer remains an outsider here--a warrior from a realm beyond the veil of this reality.

Once a great general among his people, and a valiant defender of the god-king Damathryx, Dark Seer's army was wiped out by a much larger force in the final days of the Great Boundaries War. Facing certain defeat, he made one last desperate act: he led the enemy forces into the maze between the walls. At the last moment, just before capture, he crossed over--then sealed the walls forever in an explosive release of dark energy. When the dust settled, he saw that he had saved his people but found himself blinking at the sun of a different world, with no way to return. Now he is committed to proving his worth as a military strategist, and vows to show that he's the greatest tactician this strange new world has ever seen.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_dark_seer_hype: Versatile and strategic, Dark Seer excels at manipulating the positions of his enemies. Vacuuming foes into the attacks of his allies, he can turn enemy strength against itself by pulling foes through his replicating wall.

{{Illucraft
| t = 7
| name = Dark Seer Normal Punch
| desc = for everyone}}
{{Punchcard}}

* Acquiring {{M|Aghanim's Scepter}} unlocks this ability in the {{Spellslot|4|5}}.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Grants the next attack {{M|True Strike}} when off-{{M|cooldown}}.
** {{Symbol|a|Counter}}
*** The distance accumulation counter never resets.
*** Checks and adapts the ability values accordingly per {{M|server tick}} per {{#var:Normal Punch basic1}} distance Dark Seer moved.
*** The following sources do not increase the distance counter:
**** {{M|Upward movement}} sources.
** {{Symbol|Cooldown}}
*** The [[cooldown]] starts upon a successful attack on the attacked enemy hero.
** {{Symbol|a|up}}
*** The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*** Both the {{M|knockback}} distance and duration.
*** The {{M|stun}} duration.
** Considers enemy {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, and other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.

* [[File:Dota2 Dark Seer Normal Punch icon.png|21px|Normal Punch]] {{Symbol|Illusions}}  [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The created illusion appears {{#var:Normal Punch type1 value2}} seconds later behind the affected enemy's final {{M|knockback}} location.
*** Issues an attack order on the affected enemy hero upon creation.
*** Hence, if the knockback duration is {{Code|> {{#var:Normal Punch type1 value2}}}}, the illusion may attack the affected unit before the knockback ends.
*** Successive Normal Punches applied creates another illusion with an independent duration.
** The spawn delay is not affected by {{M|status resistance}} sources on the affected enemy unit.
** The illusion bounty is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|{{G|illusion bounty level factor}} × [[Illusion#Bounty|Illusion]]<sub>LVL</sub>}}
** {{cf|talnotes}} Learning the {{ValueColor||illusion damage increasing|10tal}} {{M|talent|t=t1r}} does not update the current created illusion values.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Affects the following units:
*** Enemy {{M|illusions}}.
** {{Symbol|Trees}}
*** [[Trees]] within 100 radius of the enemy hero comes in contact with are destroyed during the knockback.

These replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will, they last until destroyed or until the wall duration ends.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
{{Illucraft
| t = 2
| name = Dark Seer Wall of Replica
| desc = for everyone}}

* All ability components considers enemy {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} and other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
** Leveling up the ability does not update the ability values of the current instance.
** {{cf|talnotes}} Learning the {{ValueColor||illusion damage increasing|10tal}} {{M|talent|t=t1r}} does not update the current created illusion values.

* This ability has three main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]]
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Dark Seer Wall of Replica icon.png|21px|Wall of Replica]] {{Symbol|Illusions}}
**** Creates [[illusions]] of affected enemy heroes with the following conditions:
***** A singles wall instance may only create {{#var:Wall of Replica type1 value1}} illusion per enemy player's first player-controlled hero-based unit within the wall radius.
***** The ability can only create another illusion of affected enemy heroes upon the created illusion's {{M|death}}.
**** Hence, the following conditions will create {{#var:Wall of Replica type1 value1}} illusion combined:
***** {{M|Clones}} and heroes of the same player.
***** {{H|Lone Druid}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}}.
***** The {{A|Enchantress|Enchant|text=Enchanted}} {{A|Dark Seer|Wall of Replica}}-based illusion.
**** Affects the following units:
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
****** However, the created illusion remains invisible.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
***** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{A|Monkey King|Wukong's Command|text=Wukong's Command Soldiers}}.
***** The {{A|Muerta|Parting Shot|text=Parting Shot Clone}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Illusions}}
*** Issues an attack order and auto-attack the corresponding enemy heroes the created illusion are based on.
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
**** The Wall of Replica-based illusion is visually distinguisable for everyone.
*** Spawns in the following sequence regardless of the enemy hero's {{M|facing angle}}:
**** [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px|East]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 North.png|31px|North]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 West.png|31px|West]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 South.png|31px|South]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px|East]].
**** {{Symbol|Illusform|1}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|1a}}
*** Has a static {{Gold|5}} and {{XP|5}} bounty.
*** The illusions duration is defined as:
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Duration {{=}} WallRemainingDuration}} 
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|21px|3]] {{Symbol|Aura}}
*** Creates a negative [[aura]] that applies the {{M|movement speed}} slow to enemy heroes within the wall's area-of-effect per {{M|server tick}}.
**** This ability component is independent of the illusion creating component.
**** Multiple overlapping wall area-of-effects do not stack.
*** The aura does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Creates the {{M|illusion}} based on the enemy hero.
*# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|dark_seer_wall_slow}}

data.name: npc_dota_hero_dark_seer
data.bio_loc:
Fast when he needs to be, and a cunning strategist, Ish'Kafel the Dark Seer requires no edged weapons to vanquish his enemies, relying instead on the strength of his powerful mind. His talent lies in his ability to maneuver the fight to his advantage. Hailing from a place he calls 'The Land behind the wall,' Dark Seer remains an outsider here--a warrior from a realm beyond the veil of this reality.

Once a great general among his people, and a valiant defender of the god-king Damathryx, Dark Seer's army was wiped out by a much larger force in the final days of the Great Boundaries War. Facing certain defeat, he made one last desperate act: he led the enemy forces into the maze between the walls. At the last moment, just before capture, he crossed over--then sealed the walls forever in an explosive release of dark energy. When the dust settled, he saw that he had saved his people but found himself blinking at the sun of a different world, with no way to return. Now he is committed to proving his worth as a military strategist, and vows to show that he's the greatest tactician this strange new world has ever seen.
data.hype_loc: Versatile and strategic, Dark Seer excels at manipulating the positions of his enemies. Vacuuming foes into the attacks of his allies, he can turn enemy strength against itself by pulling foes through his replicating wall.
data.npe_desc_loc: Pulls and manipulates his enemies' positions

abilities.name: dark_seer_vacuum
abilities.desc_loc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
abilities.lore_loc: Ish'Kafel modifies the center of gravity to a place of his choosing.
notes_loc: Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.

abilities.name: dark_seer_ion_shell
abilities.desc_loc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
abilities.lore_loc: The Dark Seer slices holes into the 'Land Behind the Wall,' causing prismatic energy to seep forth.
notes_loc: Deals small amounts of damage in %tick_interval% second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.

abilities.name: dark_seer_surge
abilities.desc_loc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
abilities.lore_loc: Ish'Kafel once used his speed of mind to navigate the maze between the walls.
notes_loc: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
abilities.shard_loc: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.

abilities.name: dark_seer_normal_punch
abilities.desc_loc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past %recent_duration% seconds. Max power is reached after %max_distance% distance moved.
abilities.lore_loc: As a young soldier, long before he became a leader of his people, Ish'Kafel was known amongst his fellow recruits as quite the pugilist.

abilities.name: dark_seer_aggrandize
abilities.desc_loc:
Dark Seer gains %int_to_atkspd% Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

abilities.name: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
abilities.desc_loc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
abilities.lore_loc: The Dark Seer, while unable to return to his natural realm, can channel part of the prismatic wall with powerful strength of mind, sowing confusion amongst enemy ranks.
notes_loc: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
